description: International Benchmarking Network for Water and Sanitation Utilities is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains World International Benchmarking Network for Water and Sanitation Utilities 2000-2013 The International Benchmarking Network for Water and Sanitation Utilities Water. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Water & Agriculture. Its keywords are Water. The portal shows 2023-06-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
